question: The speed of light in vacuum is:
solution:
The correct answer is **__299,792.458 km/s__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The speed of light in a vacuum can be **299,792.458km/s.**
 
• The speed of light in a vacuum is also denoted as **3×108 m/s**. 
 
• Sunlight takes about 8 minutes to reach the Earth. 
 
• Express the distance of the Sun from the Earth in standard form.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Formula: c = f where: c = the speed of light = **300,000 km/s** or 3.0 x 10⁸ m/s. 
 
• The wavelength of light, usually measured in meters or Ångströms (1 Å = 10⁻¹⁰ m) f = the frequency at which light waves pass by.
 
• It is measured in units per second (1/s).
